verdict.rationale: Yubico documents a public YubiEnterprise 'YubiKey as a Service' REST API for fleet delivery, inventory and shipment management, so an agent can programmatically handle the ordering and shipment part of provisioning. The pack does not show that this API covers user assignment or pre-registration (e.g., enrolling keys against an IdP before shipping), and only a single probe item supports it. ykman and the SDKs are device-level building blocks, not enterprise provisioning. Missing for 10: documented API support for key-to-user assignment and pre-registration/enrollment, endpoint-level detail of the API, and independent or hands-on corroboration of end-to-end agent-driven provisioning.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can drive key provisioning end to end — ordering, assignment, pre-registration — through documented enterprise APIs instead of a human-only console

citations.quote: the YubiEnterprise 'YubiKey as a Service' REST API documentation is live and public at console.yubico.com/apidocs/
